title: Screening of TMA Patients für ADAMTS13 Activity (Adamscreen)
brief_summary: Screening of TMA patients for ADAMTS13 activity and the description of systemic organ damage and/or organ failure in different entities of thrombotic microangiopathies (TMA)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Patients with first history of TMA as patients with recurrent TMA or TMA in complete or partial remission are eligible for analysis

Exclusion Criteria:

-Patients who received plasma intervention more than 3 weeks prior to screening must be excluded from the observational study
study_population: All patients with a constellation of thrombocytopenia, Coombs negative hemolytic anaemia and clinical signs of ischaemic end organ damage or abdominal symptoms.
